question.prompt: In right triangles \(ABC\) and \(DEF\), \(\angle C=\angle F=90^\circ\), \(AB=DE\), and \(BC=EF\). Which criterion should be used to prove congruence?

solutions.explanation: Both are right triangles. \(AB\) and \(DE\) are the hypotenuses, and \(BC\) and \(EF\) are legs. The hypotenuses and one pair of corresponding legs are equal, so use HL.
solutions.title: Identify the hypotenuses and legs
